text_en: Don't look at me like that... It's embarrassing enough to have come further than you and then end up trapped here.
I wanted to solve this on my own...
But hey, now that you're here, I'm glad to see a friendly face.
I've been wandering around this passage for a while now, so I think we can work together to clear a path for us.
And you can see the <color=OBJ>wind orb</color> in action on the way. Let's go!
